statistic: net RoR (sum realized / sum risk_capital), session-block bootstrap
rule: net RoR > E[max of N null trials] + z(confidence) * candidate session-block bootstrap SE
closed_form: E[max] = sigma_trials * ((1 - gamma) * Phi^-1(1 - 1/N) + gamma * Phi^-1(1 - 1/(N*e))); gamma = Euler-Mascheroni; E[max] = 0 at N = 1
trial_count_basis: every record in ledger/trials.jsonl at freeze time, via trials::count_trials. KTD2 asks for the count scoped to the v35 catalog lineage; that scoping is not available against the committed ledger, because v35's catalog fingerprint (ac026541...) appears in no record and no record declares a parent link into it -- the ledger's three lineage roots are era-167 (19), 3b6be31b (8) and 363f199d (2). Taking the 2-record 363f199d slice would set the bar at its lowest available value, and an undercounted trial count setting the bar too low is a named risk of this plan. The whole-ledger count is the strict reading and is what is frozen here.
rederivation_trigger: A candidate head judged on a catalog whose fingerprint differs from provenance.catalog_fingerprint must have this margin re-derived before it binds. In-range content growth changes the trade set, so both the cross-trial dispersion and the per-arm figures above are catalog-specific (AE3).
